maria: Heads-up — GCP reseller Prospectly submitted a dispute: March consolidated settlement shows incorrect commission tier applied for a bundled purchase (enterprise+support bundle). They attached settlement CSV and signed SOW. Can someone triage? :thinking_face:
ashok: Please paste the invoice lines and the settlement row they sent.
maria: Invoice excerpt:
```
INV-2026-03-7120
SKU: redwood_enterprise_bundle
Components: enterprise_license + premier_support
Qty: 1
List price: $5,000.00
Contract discount net: $4,000.00
```
Partner settlement row (as received from GCP):
```
sku,units,unit_settled,commission_pct,commission_paid
redwood_enterprise_bundle,1,4000.00,6,240.00
```
Prospectly says their signed reseller SOW guarantees 15% commission on enterprise bundles (effective 2026-03-01) so expected commission = $600. They received $240 -> shortfall $360.
julia: billing-bot, which commission profile did the exporter use for merchant=prospectly on 2026-03-31? Any recent commission-sync jobs?
billing-bot: export completed for merchant=prospectly at 2026-03-31T23:57Z. Commission profile used: COMM_PROFILE_LEGACY_6. Last commission-sync run: 2026-03-02T03:20Z. commission_table_v2 shows entry for prospectly effective 2026-03-01 commission_pct=15, but legacy_commissions still contains 6% for bundle SKU alias.
ashok: Looks like the exporter still falls back to legacy_commissions for bundle aliases. We saw this on OrbitChannel. Might be the same migration gap.
maria: Partner also attached signed SOW (s3://contracts/prospectly/sow-2026-03-01.pdf) showing 15% effective Mar 1. They want immediate confirmation they'll get the $360 difference.
kelly: AP here. For commission gaps we need: invoice id, computed delta ($360), exporter logs showing incorrect profile, signed SOW, and the commission-sync history. Attach reconciliation export and GCP ticket. Then AP can approve a provisional payout.
julia: I'll own the exporter fix and migration re-run. Plan: patch marketplace-connector to prefer commission_v2 and error if legacy entry exists for same sku+merchant; re-run migration for prospectly; add integration test. ETA: PR by EOD, migration run tomorrow morning.
ashok: Also add a monitoring rule to flag any merchant where commission_pct in v2 != legacy and settlement window includes their effective date.
maria: Drafting partner response — will offer a provisional provisional payment of $360 while we complete the audit. kelly, can AP approve provisional CM-2026-03-045 for $360 pending final reconciliation?
kelly: I can approve provisional credit for $360 with reimbursement clause. Need the reconciliation file link and GCP ticket number.
